name: Skin-normal hubs + passive cuff translation stage (non-concurrent 3R)
verdict: REFUTED as buildable (red team 2026-10-15, two lenses): its cuff is a 3-translation stage whose radial slide has no real component (stands ~25 mm: block + travel), a hard-rule failure; as logged k 722 jams (148 gap) once the verifier's VModel checks are on; repaired (neck 12-13 mm, across carriage added) it scores 37.8-38.5 on Bench(60,160) and 45.76 on Bench(110,360) exact vs the champion's 75.94. Its 2-slide subfamily is offset-skin-normal-3r.
limiter: J2 fold: reach 0.656 (51 workspace poses: across the body, behind the back with high axial, elev >= 90 in planes -15..15); near-touch metal 0.2-0.5 mm in 6 taken poses (rail #63, link 2 #152, hub 1 in the overhead peak).
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, model conventions of the verified seed-offset-3r-slides (+ bridge strap, hub1-hub2 check, centred stage). Best k 722: {"az1": 94.61, "el1": 60.68, "b1": 0.34, "az2": 24.06, "el2": 48.54, "b2": 0.42, "wd": 75.16, "wa": -13.04, "b3": 0.21, "S_max": 21.22, "centre": 1}; slide half-ranges [7.8, 8.1, 6.7]; why not taken {'fold': 51, 'slide': 0, 'flip': 0, 'skin': 3, 'parts': 1, 'contact': 0}. Optimistic: undersides fitted on the scored poses (seed lost 6.8 on Bench(110,360)). Next: CMA from k 722 until the gate passes, then the verifier. | red team 2026-10-15: chain alone (hubs + links + member 3) ib14 0.891 / gap 27.1 - the stage and reach (fold) cost the points; reach winner's curse 0.656 -> 0.592 on Bench(110,360); near-touch (<1 mm = contact) +6.5; real stage height +10 (3 mm plate) / +16 (6.5 mm).
